expectations.text: Law No. 91/2025/QH15 (PDPL) — the substantive law, in force January 1, 2026
expectations.evidence: "Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection"; "1 January 2026: Both the Law and Decree 356 took effect"

expectations.text: Decree 356/2025/ND-CP (Dec 31, 2025) — implementing detail: PDPIA/CTIA dossier forms, DPO criteria, submission timelines
expectations.evidence: "31 December 2025: The Government issued Decree No. 356/2025/ND-CP"; details DPO qualifications, "cross-border transfer impact assessment mechanics (60-day filing... six-monthly updates)" and response deadlines

expectations.text: Decree 330/2026/ND-CP (August 19, 2026, effective immediately) — the administrative sanctions layer completing the enforcement mechanism
expectations.evidence: "19 August 2026: The Government issued Decree No. 330/2026/ND-CP, which took effect the same day... operationalizes the penalty framework... 82 articles total, 33 specific to personal data protection sanctions"

expectations.text: Transition rule: violations before August 19, 2026 are judged under the law in force at the time unless Decree 330 is more lenient
expectations.evidence: No statement of the transition rule for pre-19-Aug-2026 violations (law in force at the time unless Decree 330 more lenient)

expectations.text: Identifies MPS/A05 (Department of Cyber Security and High-Tech Crime Prevention) as the enforcement authority
expectations.evidence: "administered by the Ministry of Public Security (which acts as the specialized personal data protection authority)"; "Chapter VIII — State Management... Ministry of Public Security's regulatory role"
